channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Former St. Paul Mayor Melvin Carter hired by nonprofit
item.description: Carter will serve as a “senior interim adviser” for a group distributing philanthropies’ money to other organizations.

item.title: Souhan: Olympic men’s hockey team allowed itself to be used by Donald Trump
item.description: The men could have declined their invitation to the White House as a show of solidarity with the women’s team, which also won gold in Italy. They didn’t.

item.title: Target pays $110M to end lease in downtown Minneapolis’ City Center, which is now for sale
item.description: The retailer vacated the building in 2021, but its lease was supposed to run through 2031.

item.title: Delano, Lakeville South claim section hockey titles, advance to state tournament
item.description: In other games: Andover, Grand Rapids and Warroad each won section titles to move into the state quarterfinals.

item.title: Walz decries ‘targeted retribution’ as Trump administration seeks to claw back Medicaid funds
item.description: Gov. Tim Walz says the federal government’s actions have nothing to do with the state’s Medicaid fraud crisis.

item.title: End of an era: Final D’Amico restaurants in Minnesota closing
item.description: D’Amico & Sons locations in Edina and Golden Valley will close March 28, ending a 40-year run that shaped Twin Cities dining.

item.title: Hillary Clinton testifies she has no information on Epstein's crimes and doesn't recall meeting him
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton told members of Congress on Thursday that she had no knowledge of Jeffrey Epstein's or Ghislaine Maxwell's crimes, starting off two days of depositions that will also include former President Bill Clinton.

item.title: Some Twin Cities suburbs refuse to fly the new Minnesota state flag
item.description: The redesigned flag has recently taken on greater meaning as it was waved and draped over shoulders during protests against immigration enforcement.

item.title: Chief federal judge skewers U.S. Attorney’s Office, raises threat of criminal contempt over violations
item.description: Minnesota’s chief federal judge said he’s found another 113 orders ICE has violated since late last month.

item.title: Hennepin County Attorney’s Office blasts DOJ over closed civil rights investigation
item.description: The Justice Department announced it had ended an investigation into Mary Moriarty’s office over a policy considering race in charging decisions. Her office called the investigation a “stunt.”
